name: Teen Patti
description: Teen Patti (तीन पत्ती), meaning "three cards" in Hindi, is a popular Indian vying game that combines elements of poker and bluffing. Also known as **Flash** or **Three Card Brag**, it is one of the most widely played card games in the Indian subcontinent. The game is traditionally played during festivals, especially Diwali, and has gained international recognition through online gaming platforms.

content.text: Teen Patti (तीन पत्ती), meaning "three cards" in Hindi, is a popular Indian vying game that combines elements of poker and bluffing. Also known as **Flash** or **Three Card Brag**, it is one of the most widely played card games in the Indian subcontinent. The game is traditionally played during festivals, especially Diwali, and has gained international recognition through online gaming platforms.

Country/Region of Origin: India
Time Period: Several centuries old, exact origins unknown
Etymology: "Teen" means three and "Patti" means cards in Hindi
Alternative Names: Flash, Flush, Three Card Brag (British equivalent)

Minimum Players: 3
Maximum Players: 6 (can accommodate up to 10 with variations)
Optimal Players: 4-7
Partnerships: No, every player plays individually

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Betting chips or cash
A flat surface for dealing and pot placement

Cards per Player: 3 cards face-down
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise, one card at a time
Dealer: Deals to all players including themselves
